name: Fractara: Age of Claimants
storyline:
Centuries ago, darkness consumed the Old World. The walls between worlds shattered, and other realities crashed into what was left, fighting to occupy the same ground. Between the few stable places lies the Rift: grey land where the ground forgets itself and Phase Skitterers feed on the edges of the real.

Only lanterns keep the darkness from taking everything again. Each lantern a Claimant lights pushes the Rift back and makes a small circle of the world solid once more. Enough of them make a home; held together, they make a kingdom.
summary:
Fractara: Age of Claimants is a location-based fantasy MMO set on a map of the real world. Players raise Rift Lanterns to anchor fractured reality and claim real streets as persistent territory, then build castles, forges and other structures that remain in the shared world for everyone to see.

Beyond their claims, players gather materials and craft equipment, fight creatures and bosses in real time, trade with one another, and descend into Pocket Dimensions, instanced dungeons with their own hazards and bosses. Claimants can band together into player-governed kingdoms whose borders shift as territory is claimed, reinforced, attacked and taken over.
